image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a black assault rifle (resembling an AR-15/M4 platform) against a white background. Visible components include the upper receiver with a Picatinny rail and mounted optic, a ribbed handguard, a pistol grip, a trigger guard, and a detachable box magazine. A sling is attached to the lower portion of the weapon.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Compact automatic firearm with characteristic profile of barrel receiver and stock aligned linearly.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly shows the linear alignment of the receiver, handguard, and barrel assembly typical of this class.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Overall length is substantial with barrel comprising a significant portion of total length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped; the muzzle and stock extremities are not fully visible, making total length assessment impossible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Matte black or dark gray finish.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The firearm exhibits a consistent matte black finish on both metal and polymer parts.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Metallic receiver housing firing mechanism with detachable box magazine inserted below.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The receiver is clearly defined, and a standard curved/straight hybrid magazine is visibly inserted into the mag well.
The barrel extends out of the frame to the right; the muzzle device is not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Pistol grip collapsible or fixed stock and handguard surrounding barrel.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The pistol grip is distinct. The handguard surrounds the barrel section visible in the frame. The stock connection point is visible, though the full stock is cropped.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Parkerized or anodized metal with polymer furniture.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visual texture differentiation between the metallic receiver (slight sheen) and polymer grip/handguard (matte) is consistent with real-world materials.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Upper receiver has carrying handle or Picatinny rail for optics.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A Picatinny rail is clearly visible on top of the upper receiver, with an optical sight mounted to it.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Distinguishing features include magazine well and ejection port.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The magazine well is clearly defined where the magazine inserts. The ejection port cover area is visible on the right side of the receiver.

artifact_observations.location: Sling attachment points and strap geometry
artifact_observations.reasoning: The sling straps appear to merge into the receiver body without clear, physically distinct attachment hardware (swivels). The path of the straps is slightly ambiguous, suggesting minor geometric fusion or lack of precise mechanical definition common in AI generations.

The vertical ribs on the handguard show slight irregularity in spacing and thickness towards the rear, lacking the perfect machined uniformity of a real firearm, though this could also be attributed to image resolution/compression.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model variant (e.g., M4 vs AK variant) and ensure the combination of features (rail system, mag well shape) corresponds to a valid real-world class.
To verify that the mounted optic sits correctly above the receiver and that the magazine does not clip through the receiver body, checking for subtle depth errors.
To specifically audit the boundary between the sling straps and the gun body, checking for the 'melting' artifact suspected by the Router.
To assess if the slight texture inconsistencies are due to AI generation artifacts or simple low-resolution source material.

focus_areas: Mechanical connectivity of the sling swivels
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the sling attachment points. In AI-generated firearms, soft attachments often fail to render hard mechanical swivels, resulting in straps that seem to grow out of the metal. Verify if the optic's mounting rings are structurally sound or if they blend into the rail. Check if the magazine curve matches the specific receiver type identified by the classifier.
